title: Polyglot bootstraps: resilient streaming + retry-friendly SDK templates and cookbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: ship a small, opinionated polyglot starter repo + cookbook snippets that demonstrate best-practices for streaming ergonomics, idempotent retries, backpressure, and CLI-friendly workflows. Deliverables: 1) Next.js example (client + serverless API route) showing streaming chat with incremental rendering and token-level cost annotations; 2) FastAPI example demonstrating async streaming with graceful cancellation and session-based KV cache hints; 3) Go HTTP server example with continuous-batch-friendly patterns and low-latency streaming using chunked transfer; 4) CLI reference (Python & Go) showing resumable streaming, output sanitization, and robust retry/backoff example snippets; 5) Cookbook document with copy-paste recipes for exponential backoff, idempotency tokens, chunk parsing helpers, and integrating SDK telemetry hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Starter repo exists with four subfolders: nextjs/, fastapi/, go-server/, cli/
Each example includes a README with run, test, and deploy steps (local + container)
Streaming examples show incremental render in the browser or stdout and include cancellation/unsubscribe patterns
Retry examples demonstrate safe idempotency tokens and show unit tests for transient failures (mocked 429/503 responses)
CI job runs lint, unit tests for retry logic, and smoke tests for streaming endpoints
activity: 2026-02-21: Kickoff meeting with PM/Design/Eng. Agreed to prefer minimal dependencies and to avoid framework-specific magic. Decided to prioritize DX for fast adoption.
2026-02-26: Prototype FastAPI async generator approach. Found cancellation propagation requires context manager to close KV cache. Added note to cookbook.
2026-03-02: UX review: incremental render in Next.js should expose token-level meta so devs can measure cost. Design provided mockup and token badge component (Figma link in Confluence).

2026-03-05: Engineering review: Go example changed from HTTP/2 server push to chunked transfer for broader portability. Added small benchmarking script to measure P99 latency with 1-8 concurrent streams.
2026-03-08: Security review requested for CLI opt-in telemetry; scope limited to anonymous usage counters and error rates (consent-based).
2026-03-10: PR #824 opened for initial wiring. Requesting final review for README clarity and unit test coverage before merging.
implementation_notes: Key patterns captured in code: (1) streaming parsers that accept delimiters (SSE, JSON-lines) and expose an async iterator; (2) retry wrapper that supports idempotency-token header, jittered exponential backoff, and max-attempts metric emission; (3) cancellation via context objects that signal the runtime to drop KV cache slots and close underlying transport; (4) minimal SDK shim examples showing both callback-based and async iterator streaming ergonomics for TypeScript and Python. Keep examples small (~200 LOC each) and well-documented.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: examples become heavy and opinionated; Mitigation: keep a single canonical simple pattern per language and link to advanced patterns in the cookbook. Risk: streaming semantics differ across runtimes; Mitigation: include adapter layer notes and a small compatibility table in the README.
status_notes: In Review: waiting on two reviewers (SDK lead + Docs). CI is green except for a flaky Go benchmark test that is being quarantined. Planning a docs pass to surface migration notes from previous SDK examples.
review_feedback: PM: emphasize quickstart path in README and add a single command to run all examples locally
Docs: add 'How to measure token usage' section and example alerts for quality regressions
Security: require explicit opt-in for CLI telemetry; add clear instructions for turning it off
